_doc: PKG-1 service host manifest (docs/PACKAGING_PLAN.md section 3.1), read by ops/launcher/service_host.py. Services start in list order when the APP launches and stop when it quits - never at boot. argv is interpreter-relative: the host prepends the windowless interpreter, resolves a leading .py path against the backend root, runs every service with cwd = the backend root, CREATE_NO_WINDOW and inside ONE Windows job object. Placeholders: {root}, {supervisor_config} (the per-install supervisor config the host generates under ops/runtime/launcher/). restart: always | on-failure | never. role supervisor = the one service a graceful stop asks to shut down through ops/runtime/supervisor_requests/.
_profiles_doc: Per-profile settings, merged over env for every service of that profile (the dashboard is main.py under the supervisor and inherits them). A null value REMOVES an inherited variable. RC_DASH_BIND is read by dashboard/server.py (PKG-5): an IP literal, unset keeps the wildcard bind. packaged = a default install, loopback only (PACKAGING_PLAN M5 / 3.6). dev = the operator's linked checkout: RC_DASH_BIND stays UNSET so :8888 keeps the wildcard bind the documented tailnet view needs (PACKAGING_PLAN V3). No host name or tailnet address belongs in this tracked file.
_backoff_doc: Restart-on-exit: delay = initial_s * factor^(n-1) capped at max_s, n = consecutive exits (reset by a run of at least stable_s); more than max_restarts exits inside window_s and the service reads failed until the app restarts.
